title: a close over a repo that cannot push stops loud instead of reporting the crossing
intention: close.sh and prove.sh read the status of every commit, pull and push they run, and a repo left behind or diverged from origin stops the script loud, naming the repo, before it reports any crossing.
why: Law 7: errors are loud at diagnostic surfaces. 2026-11-20 on akiendelllinux, closing 380d524e6e9c: close.sh's commit_all (close.sh:23) ran `(cd $CC && cairn artifact quiet -- git pull -q --rebase --autostash && git push -q 2>&1 | tail -1)`; the pull printed 'fatal: Cannot rebase onto multiple branches.' and the push its non-fast-forward hint (/var/tmp/close380d.1.txt lines 1-2), and close.sh went on to print '--- CROSSED TO BUILDME, NOT YET PROVED' (line 5) and exit 4 with the commons 5 commits ahead of origin. Nothing reads the subshell's status. The unpushed state surfaced only at a later PROVED crossing (the_stones_are_pushed lane); it was rebased and pushed by hand. prove.sh's commit_all (prove.sh:13) carries no pull/push but its commits and status are likewise unread. Cause of 'multiple branches' unmeasured (commons branch.main.merge is single; hypothesis: a concurrent fetch rewrote FETCH_HEAD)..
how: In close.sh, factor the pull/push into one function sync_repo <dir> that runs `cairn artifact quiet -- git pull --rebase --autostash` then `git push`, captures both statuses (no pipe that swallows them), and on any failure, or when `git rev-list @{u}..HEAD` is non-empty afterwards, prints 'NOT PUSHED: <dir>: <git's own last error line>' and returns non-zero. commit_all returns that status, and every call site of commit_all exits non-zero (a new exit code 5 = 'repo not pushed', documented in the header) before any CROSSED/PROVED line. prove.sh's commit_all gets the same status check on its commits. The proof drives the extracted commit/sync step (as test_a_close_commits_only_its_own_tickets_records does) over scratch bare-origin git repos under a scratch HOME, never the live trees, one tooth per clause.

clauses.claim: close.sh's commit step over a scratch repo whose origin is ahead with a non-conflicting commit and whose local branch has its own commit either ends with local == origin (rebased and pushed), or exits non-zero with a line naming the repo and the divergence

over a scratch repo whose pull fails (a conflicting origin commit, or a pull that errors), close.sh exits non-zero naming the repo, never prints CROSSED/PROVED, and never exits 0 or 4 while local holds commits origin lacks
over a scratch repo already in sync, close.sh's commit step still succeeds (exit status unchanged from today)

decisions.text: D1: close.sh's pull/push becomes sync_repo, whose failure or leftover unpushed commits stops the close with exit 5 before any crossing line.
D2: prove.sh's commit_all reads its commits' status the same way.
D3: the proof, one tooth per clause, over scratch bare-origin repos.
